# glpi_software_license_type (Data Source)

Look up a GLPI software license type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_software_license_type" "by_name" {
  name = "example"
}

data "glpi_software_license_type" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Name of the item. Set id or name; must match exactly one item.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `completename` (String) Full path of the item in its tree, computed by GLPI.
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the parent. 0 means top level.
